about: Flint chat format golden from the reference (render path and parsers; transformers 5.16.1): OnlineRenderer.render_chat on a stand-in model dir with the checkpoint tokenizer + chat_template.jinja, and the glm47 reasoning + tool parser (parse(), non-streaming; reference_stream = parse_delta per token). tool_calls are [] when the request's tools are off.

render.name: tools
render.prompt:
<|system|>
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>{"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get the weather", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}, "days": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["city"]}}</tools>

For each function call, output the function name and arguments within the following XML format:
<tool_call>{function-name}<arg_key>{arg-key-1}</arg_key><arg_value>{arg-value-1}</arg_value>...</tool_call>
<|user|>Weather in Paris?<|assistant|>
